blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, ORIENTAL MINDORO, Philippines — The Police Regional Office Mimaropa (Mindoro Occidental and Oriental, Marinduque, Romblon, Palawan) recorded a 51-percent drop in the combined incidence of eight focus crimes from January to October 2026, with monthly incidents falling from 118 to 58—the lowest monthly total logged during the 10-month monitoring period.
